facts.business: Jubilant Pharmova Limited is a leading radiopharmaceutical player in the US market with a diversified portfolio across PET imaging, SPECT imaging, and therapeutic products, operating a cost-efficient on-shore manufacturing facility in Montreal, Canada, and has consolidated a pure-play Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CRDMO) platform under Jubilant Biosys.
